note: The High cache path into `release/goreleaser` was judged overstated: a fork pull_request run writes only its own pull request scope, and the only base-context writer of fork code, `build-gate.yml` calling `acceptance-tests.yml`, waits on approval-gated environments (or does not exist here), so the writers are insiders and approved runs and the path holds at High at most. No job here declares cache-mode, so GitHub keeps the cache of every low-trust run read-only and grants no job cache write: ISSUE-705 is silent and no cache path exists, so the cache ceiling admits none.
